prompt: Some products name a sister product in sister_product_id; most do not, and their sister_product_id is missing. Which products of category 16, Earbuds, does no product name as its sister? Return two columns, product_id and product_name. Which query returns them?

options.text:
SELECT product_id, product_name
FROM products
WHERE category_id = 16
  AND product_id NOT IN (SELECT sister_product_id FROM products)

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id = 16
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM products s
    WHERE s.sister_product_id = p.product_id
  )

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id = 16
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM products s
    WHERE s.sister_product_id = product_id
  )

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN products s ON s.sister_product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category_id = 16
  AND s.category_id = 16
  AND s.product_id IS NULL
